tEn: AI R&D Is Accelerating Towards Potential RSI in 2027
tZh: AI 研发正加速迈向 2027 年潜在的递归自我改进
sEn: METR data suggests AI-driven R&D acceleration could lead to near-full automation of AI research by end-2027, implying possible recursive self-improvement within under a year.
sZh: METR 数据显示 AI 驱动的研发加速可能使 AI 研究在 2027 年底接近全自动化，意味着不到一年内可能出现递归自我改进。
absEn: This article examines a METR report on how AI is accelerating AI research and development at Anthropic, arguing that the pace of capability progress has roughly doubled relative to the March 2024 to October 2025 period, with a majority of that acceleration likely attributable to AI performing R&D. METR finds no observed bottlenecks or strong diminishing returns that would prevent further acceleration, and extrapolating Anthropic's internal data suggests Claude could lead internal research by mid-2027 and plausibly reach near-full automation by the end of 2027, consistent with the AI 2027 timeline and implying possible recursive self-improvement within less than a year. The author notes that many readers updated toward shorter timelines, though the report's most informative evidence was heavily redacted by Anthropic, forcing the public to rely on METR's judgment. The conclusion is that the situation looks grim and time is running out, but the outcome is not fixed: labs could stop, estimates could be wrong, or bottlenecks could emerge, and if acceleration proceeds this quickly it would likely go poorly, though it might go well.
absZh: 本文审视了 METR 一份关于 AI 如何在 Anthropic 加速 AI 研发的报告，认为能力进展的速度相较 2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 10 月期间大约翻了一倍，其中大部分加速很可能归因于 AI 执行研发工作。METR 未发现会阻碍进一步加速的瓶颈或强烈的收益递减，而对 Anthropic 内部数据的推断表明，Claude 可能在 2027 年年中主导内部研究，并有望在 2027 年底实现接近完全自动化，这与 AI 2027 时间线一致，并意味着可能在不到一年内出现递归自我改进。作者指出，许多读者因此将时间线预期缩短，但报告中最具信息量的证据被 Anthropic 大量涂黑，迫使公众依赖 METR 的判断。结论是形势严峻、时间无多，但结果并非注定：实验室可能停下，估计可能出错，瓶颈也可能出现；若加速如此之快，结果很可能不妙，但也可能向好。

contrib.en: METR finds Anthropic's capability progress roughly doubled versus March 2024–October 2025, with wide uncertainty.

contrib.en: No observed bottlenecks or strong diminishing returns were found that would prevent further acceleration in the next 12 months.

contrib.zh: 外推内部数据表明 Claude 可能在 2027 年中主导内部研究，2027 年底接近完全自动化。

contrib.en: Acceleration was not due to faster scaling of training compute, per METR's analysis.
contrib.zh: 据 METR 分析，加速并非源于训练算力规模扩张的加快。

limits.zh: Anthropic 大量删减了最有信息量的证据，公众只能依赖 METR 的判断而非可验证数据。

items.en: A world made of gears. Doing both speed premium short term updates and long term world model building. Currently focused on weekly AI updates. Explorations include AI, policy, rationality, medicine and fertility, education and games.
items.zh: 一个由齿轮构成的世界。同时进行速度优先的短期更新与长期世界模型构建。目前专注于每周 AI 更新。探索领域包括 AI、政策、理性、医学与生育、教育与游戏。

items.en: **METR came out with an extensive report** on how much AI is accelerating AI R&D at Anthropic, and thus how close we might be to recursive self-improvement (RSI) and how far that might go.
items.zh: **METR 发布了一份详尽的报告**，说明 AI 在 Anthropic 内部加速 AI 研发的程度，以及由此我们距离递归自我改进（RSI）有多近、这一进程可能走多远。

items.en: This is one of the most important questions in the world.
items.zh: 这是世界上最重要的问题之一。

items.en: Their answer: Things are already accelerating on the order of a 2x speedup.
items.zh: 他们的答案是：事情已经在以约 2 倍加速的量级推进。

items.en: This is several months ahead of the AI 2027 timeline. A naive extrapolation says we may be less than a year away from full RSI. There are no clear bottlenecks in the way.
items.zh: 这比 AI 2027 时间线提前了数月。一个朴素的推断表明，我们距离完全 RSI 可能不到一年。前进道路上没有明显的瓶颈。

items.en: This report updated many towards shorter timelines.
items.zh: 这份报告使许多人对更短时间线的预期进行了更新。

items.en: This is consistent with what OpenAI and Anthropic themselves have been saying, and with extrapolation from the progress we are observing. We are running out of time.
items.zh: 这与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 自身一直以来的说法一致，也与从我们观察到的进展所做外推一致。我们的时间不多了。

items.en: That doesn't have to be the way this plays out. We could stop the labs. The labs could choose to stop. Or the estimates could be wrong, or some bottlenecks could be hit, or the results could be less impactful than we expect. Indeed, many things do come to pass. And if it does happen this quickly, one would expect it to go quite poorly, and likely to cause everyone to die, but perhaps it goes well.
items.zh: 事情未必非要如此发展。我们可以叫停这些实验室。实验室也可以选择停下。或者估计可能是错的，或者可能撞上某些瓶颈，或者结果的影响可能没有我们预期的那么大。的确，许多事情终会发生。而如果它真的这么快就发生，人们会预期它进展得相当糟糕，很可能导致所有人死亡，但也许它会进展顺利。

items.en: 1. **Capabilities are advancing at roughly twice the rate** they did from March 2024 to October 2025 (CI ~1.3x-3x), with wide uncertainty. And that a majority of that acceleration is probably due to AI doing AI R&D. Since October 2025, Anthropic has made ~2x progress on the ECI versus periods prior to October 2025.
items.zh: 1. **能力提升的速度大约是** 2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 10 月期间的**两倍**（CI 约 1.3 倍至 3 倍），且不确定性很大。而且这种加速的大部分可能归因于 AI 在做 AI 研发。自 2025 年 10 月以来，Anthropic 在 ECI 上取得的进展约为 2025 年 10 月之前各时期的 2 倍。

items.en: 1. Yes, this seems like what has been obviously happening.
items.zh: 1. 是的，这看起来就是一直显而易见正在发生的事。

items.en: 2. **There are no observed bottlenecks or strong diminishing returns** that would prevent advancement from accelerating further.
items.zh: 2. **未观察到任何会阻止进展进一步加速的瓶颈或强烈的收益递减现象。**

items.en: 1. Unfortunately, Anthropic redacted the analysis of various bottlenecks.
items.zh: 1. 遗憾的是，Anthropic 对各类瓶颈的分析进行了涂黑处理。

items.en: METR: These conclusions are based on key empirical findings from the full report.
items.zh: METR：这些结论基于完整报告中的关键实证发现。

items.en: Some of the key findings that most informed our conclusions about risk were redacted.
items.zh: 一些对我们风险结论影响最大的关键发现被涂黑处理了。

items.en: Ajeya Cotra (METR): For the last few months, some of my colleagues at METR have been working on a deep-access investigation to understand how much Anthropic is being accelerated by its AI systems. **From my reading of their report and Anthropic's RSP, it looks like the "dramatic acceleration" threshold has already been crossed.**
items.zh: Ajeya Cotra（METR）：过去几个月里，我在 METR 的一些同事一直在进行一项深度访问调查，以了解 Anthropic 在多大程度上被其 AI 系统加速。**根据我对他们报告和 Anthropic RSP 的阅读，看起来“剧烈加速”的阈值已经被跨越了。**

items.en: I do not find either of these results surprising. I made minor updates towards faster outcomes and fewer bottlenecks, but not major ones. I had already made major ones.
items.zh: 这两个结果我都不感到意外。我做过一些小幅更新，倾向于更快的结果和更少的瓶颈，但没有做重大更新。重大更新我早已做过。

items.en: The situation looks rather grim. But this is not a surprise.
items.zh: 情况看起来相当严峻。但这并不令人意外。

items.en: The information from inside the labs makes you think the situation is grim and timelines are short, but those with that information were already shouting from the rooftops that their secret information meant the situation is grim and timelines were short. Why did you not think this was the standard reaction to their information?
items.zh: 来自实验室内部的信息会让你认为情况严峻、时间线很短，但掌握这些信息的人早已在屋顶上大声疾呼：他们的秘密信息意味着情况严峻、时间线很短。你为什么不认为这是他们信息所引发的标准反应呢？

items.en: I did find it surprising that so many found this surprising, including METR. Their team did not expect substantial acceleration. Ryan Greenblatt expected only a 1.15x-1.3x speedup this year. Six weeks ago in the Opus 5.5 system card the estimate was at least a 1.5x speedup.
items.zh: 我确实感到意外的是，包括 METR 在内的这么多人竟对此感到意外。他们的团队并未预期会出现大幅加速。Ryan Greenblatt 预计今年只会带来 1.15 倍至 1.3 倍的加速。六周前在 Opus 5.5 的系统卡中，估计至少是 1.5 倍的加速。

items.en: If you are making major updates in response to this report, that is probably good and wise, but indicates you had previously made a mistake in your estimations.
items.zh: 如果你正因这份报告而做出重大更新，那大概是好的、明智的，但这表明你此前在估计中犯了错误。

items.capEn: If you only look at public models, you can make a case that there is a step change at Mythos but that otherwise the rate of progress has not changed. I was always skeptical of that, but it was a valid claim.
items.capZh: 如果只看公开模型，你可以论证在 Mythos 处存在阶跃变化，但除此之外进展速度并未改变。我一直对此持怀疑态度，但这是一个合理的说法。

items.en: Add in the orange data points from internal models and you cannot tell that story. When we include the recent additional internal releases, this takes the estimate from the ~1.7x in the Haiku system card up to a new estimate of ~1.9x.
items.zh: 把来自内部模型的橙色数据点加进来，你就讲不出那个故事了。当我们把近期新增的内部发布也纳入考虑，这会把估计值从 Haiku 系统卡片中的约 1.7 倍提升到约 1.9 倍的新估计。

items.en: Peter Wildeford: It seems important to realize that:
items.zh: Peter Wildeford：似乎重要的是要认识到：

items.en: - AI companies have unreleased internal models that are more powerful than the public ones we plebs have access to
items.zh: - AI 公司拥有未发布的内部模型，它们比我们这些普通人所能访问的公开模型更强大

items.en: - Only when you account for these internal models, you can see that AI progress is actually accelerating faster than before
items.zh: - 只有把这些内部模型考虑在内，你才能看到 AI 的进展实际上比之前加速得更快

items.en: - AI companies use their AIs with like 10,000x more compute than us plebs, so they can do much more than we can even with the same AIs
items.zh: - AI 公司使用其 AI 时所用的算力大约是我们的 10,000 倍，因此即便使用相同的 AI，它们能做的事情也远比我们多

items.zh: Benjamin Todd：对 Anthropic 内部的 AI 研发数据进行外推，结果表明 Claude 将在 2027 年中期主导内部研究，并且到 2027 年底有可能接近完全自动化，这与其他方法的结果一致。（感谢 @luc_feron）

items.capEn: The information METR is relying on most is largely redacted. The public report centers on AECI and other estimates. METR is implying that such arguments are merely the legible case they are allowed to make, and that there is a stronger case.
items.capZh: METR 最依赖的信息大部分被涂黑。公开报告聚焦于 AECI 和其他估计。METR 暗示这类论点只是他们被允许做出的可读案例，而存在更强的案例。

items.en: Kudos to Anthropic for allowing this investigation.
items.zh: 感谢 Anthropic 允许开展这项调查。

items.en: METR: Anthropic offered unprecedented access to internal data on their AI R&D process, including a variety of metrics on pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL), training compute in each domain, benchmark scores for internal models, AI speedup analyses, forecasts of a future model's metrics, and interviews with relevant staff.
items.zh: METR：Anthropic 提供了前所未有的内部数据访问权限，涵盖其 AI 研发过程，包括关于预训练、强化学习（RL）、各领域的训练算力、内部模型的基准分数、AI 加速分析、对未来模型指标的预测，以及与相关员工的访谈等多种指标。

items.en: This is all highly sensitive stuff, so there are important redactions involved. I would have liked to see less of this, but if this is what it takes to get the report then so be it.
items.zh: 这些都是高度敏感的内容，因此涉及重要的删减。我本希望能看到更少的删减，但如果这是获得该报告所必须付出的代价，那就这样吧。

items.en: I would also suggest to Congress that they should want to see the full report, along with everything else Anthropic and Dario Amodei know and really think about this, and to do that they should follow Kelsey Piper's suggestion and subpoena Anthropic.
items.zh: 我还想建议国会：他们应当希望看到完整报告，以及 Anthropic 和 Dario Amodei 所知道的、对这件事真正思考过的一切其他内容；为此，他们应当采纳 Kelsey Piper 的建议，传唤 Anthropic。
